answer: The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in sparrow, expire in wharf, and pulse lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 13 aliases therefore needs 63 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4407 identities would post 3625 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
